an5.74:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.74:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu dhammavihārī hotī’ti?
an5.74:2.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
an5.74:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.74:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti. uttariñcassa paññāya atthaṃ nappajānāti.
an5.74:3.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu, bhikkhu saññattibahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.74:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. uttariñcassa paññāya atthaṃ nappajānāti.
an5.74:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu, bhikkhu sajjhāyabahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.74:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati. uttariñcassa paññāya atthaṃ nappajānāti.
an5.74:5.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu, bhikkhu vitakkabahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.74:6.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an5.74:6.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti.
an5.74:7.1: iti kho bhikkhu desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito saññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.
an5.74:7.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhu, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
an5.74:7.3: etāni bhikkhu, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhu, mā pamādattha. mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
